title: Dentsply Sirona Announces Five Free Dental Webinars
html:
Five complimentary webinars in November and December explore digital workflows, clear aligner treatment planning, and orthodontic treatment, with one CE credit available per session.

Dentsply Sirona is inviting dental professionals to expand their clinical and practice management knowledge through five complimentary live webinars taking place in November and December 2026. Covering clear aligner case selection, connected implant workflows, digital scanning, and orthodontic treatment planning, the sessions offer practical guidance for dental professionals at different stages of their careers.

Led by Drs. Elio Filice, Joe Chichetti, Brian Gaudreault, Reena Patel, and Cory Costanzo, the program combines case discussions with practical insights for dental professionals and their teams. Each one-hour webinar offers one continuing education credit.

Selecting appropriate cases for clear aligner treatment

On November 10, from 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Dr. Elio Filice will lead “The Right Patient, The Right Case: A Case-Selection Framework for Clear Aligners.” Designed for general dentists, the webinar will provide a practical framework for identifying suitable candidates for SureSmile Clear Aligners, evaluating case complexity, and determining when specialist referral is indicated. Clinical examples will address mild crowding, orthodontic relapse, and pre-restorative treatment, alongside patient factors such as oral health, adherence, and expectations. Participants will also explore how digital treatment simulation, clinician-led lab support, and a structured workflow can support clinical decision-making and patient communication.

Registration link

Connecting the digital implant workflow

On November 17, from 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Dr. Joe Chichetti will present “Click to Crown: How CBCT, Primeprint, and DS Core Turn Implant Planning into Case Acceptance.” Through a clinical case walkthrough and live navigation of the workflow, the session will explore the connections between CBCT-driven diagnosis, virtual treatment planning, guided surgery, and final restoration. Participants will learn how in-house surgical guide fabrication using Primeprint can support the implant workflow and how DS Core can help clinicians visualize treatment plans and communicate with patients.

Registration link

Building confidence with elastics in clear aligner therapy

On December 8, from 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Dr. Brian Gaudreault will lead “Understanding Elastics with SureSmile Aligners.” Designed for dentists and clinical teams, the webinar will examine the biomechanical role of interarch elastics and clinical situations in which they may support treatment, including selected Class II and Class III malocclusions, midline corrections, and vertical corrections. The session will address how attachments, cutouts, buttons, and staging considerations support elastic mechanics, alongside common challenges such as patient adherence. Participants will also explore practical communication strategies to support elastic wear.

Registration link

Helping patients understand their treatment needs through digital scanning

On December 15, from 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Dr. Reena Patel will present “Digital Scanning: A Path to Practice Growth and Showing Patients Their ‘WHY?’” Through live demonstrations and clinical examples, the webinar will explore how cloud-native scanning with Primescan 2 and DS Core can support daily workflows, team collaboration, and patient education. Participants will examine when to scan, the differences between status and treatment scans, and ways to make digital impressions a routine part of the practice. The session will also address team adoption and scan-driven patient conversations to help patients better understand their oral health and proposed treatment.

Registration link

Bringing roots and bone into orthodontic planning

On December 17, from 7:30 to 8:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Dr. Cory Costanzo will present “Crown to Root Precision for the Orthodontist in Diagnosis, Treatment Planning, and Aligner Design.” The webinar will explore how integrating CBCT into digital simulations allows clinicians to consider root movement and bony limitations during aligner planning. Using clinical cases, Dr. Costanzo will discuss the interplay between forces acting on teeth, staging strategies, aligner trim-line alternatives, and attachment utilization. Participants will also examine the capabilities of a user-modifiable aligner planning and staging platform.

Registration link

Supporting lifelong learning through DS Academy

These webinars are part of Dentsply Sirona Academy’s broader commitment to supporting dental professionals throughout their careers. Through clinical education that connects scientific knowledge with practical application, DS Academy helps clinicians and their teams build confidence, develop their skills, and integrate evolving technologies and treatment approaches into everyday practice.

For more details, visit DS Academy: Flexible Dental Education for Professional Growth | Dentsply Sirona USA.

About Dentsply Sirona

Dentsply Sirona is the world’s largest diversified manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with over a century of innovation and service to the dental industry and patients worldwide. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including dental and oral health products as well as other consumable medical devices under a strong portfolio of world-class brands. Dentsply Sirona’s innovative products provide high-quality, effective, and connected solutions to advance patient care and deliver better and safer dental care. Dentsply Sirona is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. The Company’s shares are listed in the United States on Nasdaq under the symbol XRAY.

Visit www.dentsplysirona.com for more information about Dentsply Sirona and its products.
